name: search-wikipedia
description: Wikipedia MediaWiki action-API search adapter (SRC-06). Free and keyless; zero capabilities (no `paid`, no secrets). The single permitted network host is en.wikipedia.org (search + page content). Activation is terms-gated: config must name the dated plans/sources.md entry that clears this source. Content is CC BY-SA — the evidence store preserves attribution (source URL + title per passage); publishing derived content would require the same license.
